title: Canonical units and maps for principal strict total limits
statement: For a small ringed site with independently sized objects and morphisms, use the module category, strict tensor Koszul and quotient towers and total right-derived inverse limit of [def-pur-principal-koszul-quotient-towers], [def-sf-koszul-total-derived-limit] and the normalized augmentation of [def-sf-normalized-strict-tower-augmentation]. Define koszulUnit and quotientUnit by precomposition with the inverse of the specified representative isomorphism, comparison by applying the specified total limit to the strict quotient comparison, tensorTowerMap by tensoring a chain map, koszulMap and quotientMap by total limit, and restriction by the recorded derived restriction functor. These are actual maps with no exact product, regularity, or flatness assumption. The auxiliary tensorComplexMap is the same total tensor bifunctor map, kept behind a named natural transformation. towerLimit is the chosen total derived limit of an arbitrary strict tower. locallyComplete abbreviates the original slice-wise localization/internal-Hom test; it adds no hypothesis and changes no test.

from.place: Proof sentence “The maps used here are tensor reassociation, evaluation, and adjunction units and counits”; integral open factor, existential quotient Roos triangle versus the canonical Koszul unit (returned item Steps 6-7).
